note: spec 14 §10.4. install: compare ok, error, rows (state, error, source_kind, folder, files, bytes), messages, installed, tree, manifest (format; per part source_kind, folder, files). Not compared: rows.*.name, manifest engine/installed_utc/source, message texts. Each install case starts from a fresh copy of homes/<start_home> (or a non-existent home) and runs its steps in order on the same home. resolve: run with the given args and env (unset OUTNUMBERED_HOME and leave XDG_DATA_HOME/HOME alone unless listed); <home> = the home folder, <T> = a temporary folder; home_created = whether the home folder exists after the run (resolve never creates it). Paths in the engine output are native and absolute; compare after replacing the <home>/<T> prefixes. Cue case is optional.
